name: treeroom-1
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; Object.assign(state.access, { showSolids: true, boxColor: "#ffffff" }); Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, bridges: 5, toys: 24, pictures: 2, inside: 1, figX: 0, figY: 60 }); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const pic = document.getElementById("pic"), inv = pic.getScreenCTM().inverse(), R = el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), a = new DOMPoint(r.left, r.top).matrixTransform(inv), b = new DOMPoint(r.right, r.bottom).matrixTransform(inv); return [a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y].map(Math.round); }; const node = bgShown.node, portals = [...node.querySelectorAll(".portal, [data-ladder]")].map(p => ({ what: ((p.closest("[data-obj]") || { dataset: {} }).dataset.obj || "") + "/" + (p.getAttribute("data-ladder") ? "ladder" : p.dataset.to || p.dataset.room || p.dataset.house || "door"), r: R(p), el: p })); const objs = [...node.querySelectorAll("[data-obj]")].filter(o => !o.querySelector(".portal, [data-ladder]") && !o.closest(".portal, [data-ladder]")); const over = []; for (const p of portals) for (const o of objs) { const r = R(o), ix = Math.min(r[2], p.r[2]) - Math.max(r[0], p.r[0]), iy = Math.min(r[3], p.r[3]) - Math.max(r[1], p.r[1]); if (ix > 4 && iy > 4 && (p.el.compareDocumentPosition(o) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING)) over.push([o.dataset.obj, p.what, ix, iy]); } window.__report = { room: state.background["room" + state.background.inside], portals: portals.map(p => [p.what, ...p.r]), over, solids: solidsHere().map(o => [o.name, Math.round(o.x0), Math.round(o.x1), Math.round(o.back), Math.round(o.front)]) };
